सुयज्ञा

SUYAJÑĀ . Daughter of King prasenajit of the pūru dynasty. She was wedded to King mahābhauma and King Ayutanāyī was their son. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 95, Verse 20).

सुयजु

SUYAJU . A King who was the grandson of Emperor bharata and son of Bhumanyu. His mother was puṣkariṇī. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 94, Verse 24).

सुयम

SUYAMA . Third son of the rākṣasa called śataśṛṅga. sudeva, the army-chief of King ambarīṣa, killed suyama. (M.B. Southern text, śānti Parva, Chapter 98).

सुयशा १

SUYAŚĀ I . A daughter of King Bāhuda and wife of parīkṣit, son of Anaśvā. The couple had a son called Bhīmasena. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 95, Verse 41).

सुयशा २

SUYAŚĀ II . Consort of King divodāsa of kāśī. (For details see under nikumbha).
